Nordiheim have 2 national airlines:
Nordi Air - The international airline wich focuses mostly on flights to other nations and between them if they are allowed.
Heim Air - The internal airline that focuses mostly on air travel between the different regions, especialy between the Argos part and the Nordland and Olia regions in shamat.

Both of them are 50% owned by the nation and the largest airplane they have is the CAP41 Bara (a civilian version of the HT42Cr Mob) that are nicknamed the Capibara by Nordiheimian pilots, with Heim Air having a lot of smaller airplanes compared to Nordi Air.
While they are not the most luxurious airlines to fly with their comfort levels are ok and the price not to high, they do take safety pretty seriously tough.
